title: The Type of a Rational Hodge Counterexample
description: Records the two Lean 4 types of a rational Hodge negation (RationalHodgeNegation and RationalCounterexample), proves they are classically equivalent (counterexample_to_negation constructively without extra axioms, and negation_to_counterexample via Classical.choice), and records that both types are uninhabited in this repository. Separates the false integral Hodge conjecture (Atiyah–Hirzebruch 1961 torsion counterexamples; Kollár 1990 infinite-order integral counterexamples) from the open rational Clay Millennium statement. Does not produce a counterexample fourfold or class, and does not claim the Clay Millennium Prize.
